## Specification Check

Before requesting review, confirm the implementation was checked against `docs/GAME_DESIGN.md`.

### Design
- [ ] I checked the change against `docs/GAME_DESIGN.md`.
- [ ] The futuristic SF + Japanese-inspired world direction is preserved.
- [ ] The gamepad-first design is preserved.
- [ ] Responsive, high-speed action remains the intended player experience.
- [ ] Crowd combat requirements are preserved where relevant.
- [ ] The change does not unnecessarily move scope away from the current development phase.
- [ ] No copyrighted/reference-work creative content was copied.

### Engineering
- [ ] Responsibilities of changed classes/systems remain clear.
- [ ] Existing behavior that should remain was considered.
- [ ] Relevant tests/build checks were run, or the reason they could not be run is documented.

### Specification Change
- [ ] No game-design change was required.
- [ ] A game-design change was required and `docs/GAME_DESIGN.md` was updated accordingly.

### Summary
Describe briefly how the change supports the current game-design specification.
